title: garcinia sessilis
intro: Garcinia sessilis, commonly known as the Borneo yellow garcinia, is a species of flowering plant in the family Clusiaceae. It is native to Southeast Asia, particularly in Malaysia and Indonesia. Research has shown that this plant has various health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, as well as potential applications in managing obesity and improving lipid profiles. The bioactive constituents of Garcinia sessilis include flavonoids, xanthones, and alkaloids, which contribute to its therapeutic actions, including anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antiproliferative effects.
